coverage_axes.axis: Observed victim reuse and dirty forwarding
coverage_axes.missing: No reuse-distance distribution, sector usefulness distribution, or critical-path attribution; installs/retention without actual responses are not reuse benefit.
coverage_axes.observed: CFD49962/101 and DWT23305/943 read/dirty-forward responses; Conv36/0; SAD0/0; Vector0/0
coverage_axes.quantification: F victim read responses and dirty_forward_responses; reuse ratio requires matching active directory_queries denominator

coverage_axes.missing: No disjoint GPU stall share, DRAM saturation proof or general benefit across dirty reuse intensities.
coverage_axes.observed: All five write WB bytes; S WB_DATA_SPACE waits from0(SAD) to848913(Conv); F measured0 in this reason for all5
coverage_axes.quantification: lower WB bytes plus request-wait observations for WB_DATA_SPACE and SAME_ADDRESS_WB; preserve independent wait scopes

coverage_axes.axis: RO coalescing versus actual Tag release
coverage_axes.missing: Application-level performance with actual successful Tag detach is absent; merges alone do not establish bandwidth relief or saturation relief.
coverage_axes.observed: 4/5 F inputs have RO admissions/merges; all5 have detached0. Vector1000000 admissions,250118 transactions,749882 merges but S/F lower reads both1000000
coverage_axes.quantification: accepted_ro, transactions, merges, detached, peak independent lower lines, line-MSHR full waits

coverage_axes.axis: Working-set and temporal locality / set conflict
coverage_axes.missing: No established reuse-distance distribution, simultaneous live working set, baseline per-set occupancy/conflict rates, or size-scaling series. Static epoch union line counts are not temporal L2 working set.
coverage_axes.observed: Certified RO-line counts396..294912; kernels1..10; new capacity accepted CFD/Vector Tag replacement sums0 and max Tag identity bounds1570/5862 of65536
coverage_axes.quantification: Existing oracle per-line classifications; active replacement counts and source-proven occupancy bounds where available

coverage_axes.missing: Cannot label CFD irregular, Vector streaming, SAD compute-bound, or any workload representative solely from names. Candidate source/provenance must support descriptors.
coverage_axes.observed: None of the consumed accepted projections provides these distributions
coverage_axes.quantification: Candidate feature evidence should use address-stride/warp-sector footprint, dependent-load depth, graph/frontier degree distribution or known exact data structure accesses

coverage_axes.missing: No exclusive bank stall-time share or hardware port-count sensitivity; exempt logical service cannot imply zero physical cost or a monotone hardware bound.
coverage_axes.observed: All5 physical S/F demand drops; S grants483611..9217033; S/F elapsed signs mixed. Conv finite DATA_FREE S+599/F-149 and COPY_FREE+739; DWT COPY_FREE+36
coverage_axes.quantification: Physical bank grants, DATA_SERVICE first-wait observations, per-kernel elapsed controls; normalize same-binary only

coverage_axes.missing: Traffic bytes or request-wait sums alone do not prove bandwidth-bound or latency-bound behavior. No matching DRAM busy fraction/effective bandwidth roof coverage is established here.
coverage_axes.observed: Main S read bytes12768..75504832; Conv line-MSHR waits40088->150118; Vector MissQ waits1131061->818741; other inputs include zero wait cases
coverage_axes.quantification: Read/WB bytes, native concurrency highwaters, MissQ/line-MSHR waits; achieved DRAM utilization needs rate/active/busy counters in matching clock domains

coverage_axes.missing: Five exact inputs are not five sampled populations; one frozen P1 hardware configuration and no general size sweep. No cross-binary aggregation with new capacity diagnostics.
coverage_axes.observed: Kernel count1,2,3,5,10; DWT WV->F+925 concentratedK5/K8 although RO admissions onlyK1; Vector single-kernel regression
coverage_axes.quantification: UID-matched kernel durations and conditional controls, exact per-input trace; dataset-size/hardware parameters independent of application count

main_claim_boundary: Five exact accepted inputs demonstrate mixed benefits and overheads under one frozen hardware point. Quantity alone cannot establish representativeness or increase original seven denominator; missing strata must be stated explicitly.
